metadata.policy: Archaeology-first UDM20 Second-Pass Standard: Ground-truth and natural pattern emergence first with zero forced interpretation. All modern South Slavic metalanguage labels (vožd, pisar, posuda, žito, etc.), Ottoman Turkish loans (balkan, zanat), and anachronistic Late PIE root reconstructions (*wedh-, *peik-, *gerh2-, *peku-, *dom-) from the 2025-10-27 merge have been stripped from active transliterations/meanings and archived in legacy_slavic_glosses_deprecated. Active roots reflect reconstructed Pre-Indo-European (Old European / Danubian / Aegean-Balkan) and Nostratic macro-substrate forms bound via the Syntactical Forcing Function.

linguistic_principles.word_order: Register-dependent: Proto-SOV (Liturgical/Dedicatory, e.g., Tărtăria Tablet 1), Analytic OVS (Technical/Hydrological Engineering, e.g., Dispilio Tablet), and Tabular [Authority]+[Resource]+[Quantity] (Commodity Accounting)

methodology.description: Universal Decipherment Methodology v20 (UDM20) Second-Pass Protocol. Evaluates every glyph across four independent empirical vectors: Internal Structural/Positional Syntax (30%), Archaeological/Stratigraphic Context with Material Veto (30%), Cross-Corpus Semasiographic Convergence across the 4,500-year Anatolian-Danubian continuum and 137-script matrix (25%), and Pre-IE Substrate Linguistics (15%).
